# Topic Desk Studio v0.4.2 — English

This patch reduces unnecessary native browser frame updates while reading.

- Keep the existing browser frame when focus or layout notifications report unchanged geometry.
- Continue to repair actual native position or size changes, with tolerance for display scaling and rounding.
- Add regression coverage for unchanged frames, display scaling, and native frame drift.

The intermittent rightward content shift has not yet been reproduced and confirmed resolved. This patch addresses a suspected trigger.

---

# Topic Desk Studio v0.4.2 — 中文

本次补丁减少阅读过程中不必要的原生浏览器区域更新。

- 焦点或布局通知未改变实际区域时，保留浏览器现有位置和尺寸。
- 实际位置或尺寸变化时仍执行恢复，并兼容显示缩放与坐标取整。
- 新增区域不变、显示缩放和原生区域偏移的回归测试。

偶发的页面内容右偏尚未复现并确认解决；此补丁针对可疑触发路径进行修正。
